opening.argument: The video explains why children may blink excessively through an optometrist’s account of common causes, including dry eyes, inturned lashes, and allergic conjunctivitis. Its focus is eyecare information: the speaker identifies a possible cause and advises viewers who are unsure to check with a local optometrist. The accompanying practice website and appointment invitation sit alongside that advice as ordinary service promotion. They do not turn the explanation into a money-making offer or a request for credentials. The material gives viewers reasons to seek professional eyecare without claiming that the video itself replaces professional advice.

citations.quote: This video outlines the most common causes of excessive blinking I see in children as an optometrist.
If in doubt, check. With your local optometrist first.
the information presented here is not a substitute for any kind of professional advice
